selected.description: The value of the tab whose panel is showing. The strip is the one writer of its children's selected state, so a host owns this and nothing else.

label.description: The accessible name of the strip. A tablist is named by nothing else — it takes no name from its tabs — and no lint can say so, because a bound role switches the naming rules off. Name every strip.

activation.description: auto selects a tab as the caret lands on it; manual moves the caret alone and waits for Enter or Space. auto is right for a strip whose panels are already built, manual for one whose panels cost something to show.

orientation.description: horizontal or vertical. It chooses which arrow keys move the caret, and which edge carries both the strip's rule and the selected tab's mark on it — a tab cannot see the strip's orientation from its own sheet, so the strip draws that mark.

applySelection.description: Writes the selection onto the tabs and returns it. Idempotent: it runs inside a render effect.

onKeydown.description: The tab keyboard contract: the arrows of the strip's orientation move the caret with wrap, Home and End go to the ends, Enter and Space activate under manual activation, and Delete closes a closable tab.

onSelect.description: A tab was activated: selected is written first, then change is dispatched, so a listener reading e.target.selected sees the new value.

emits.name: change
emits.description: The selection moved; detail is the newly selected tab's value.

onReady.description: Gives the strip its first sight of itself and syncs the tabs. Not optional: applyAttributes runs before distributeSlots, so no tab exists when the root's bindings first evaluate.

onMount.description: Announces that the strip has rendered and taken its slotted tabs, which is how onReady reaches the element itself.
